conversations.title: Leaking Faucet Call
conversations.description: Call a plumber to report a leaking faucet in the kitchen.

messages.text: Pronto, Idraulica Rossi. Come posso aiutarla?
messages.english: Hello, Rossi Plumbing. How can I help you?

choices.text: Buongiorno, ho un problema con un rubinetto in cucina.
choices.english: Good morning, I have a problem with a faucet in the kitchen.
choices.feedback: Perfect! You clearly stated the problem and the location.

choices.text: Ciao, vorrei comprare un biglietto per il cinema stasera.
choices.english: Hi, I would like to buy a movie ticket for tonight.
choices.feedback: Wrong place! This is a plumber, not a cinema.

choices.text: Buongiorno, mi piace molto l'acqua calda della doccia.
choices.english: Good morning, I really like the hot water in the shower.
choices.feedback: You need to report the problem, not give a compliment.

messages.text: Capisco. Il rubinetto perde molta acqua o solo poche gocce?
messages.english: I see. Is the faucet leaking a lot of water or just a few drops?

choices.text: Perde molto, è urgente perché c'è molta acqua a terra.
choices.english: It's leaking a lot, it's urgent because there's a lot of water on the floor.
choices.feedback: Good. Describing the urgency helps the plumber prioritize.

choices.text: L'acqua è molto buona da bere quando ho molta sete.
choices.english: The water is very good to drink when I am very thirsty.
choices.feedback: That's not relevant to the repair request.

choices.text: Sì, il mio cane beve poche gocce d'acqua ogni ora.
choices.english: Yes, my dog drinks a few drops of water every hour.
choices.feedback: The plumber is asking about the leak, not your dog.

messages.text: D'accordo. Deve chiudere l'acqua centrale per sicurezza. Sa come fare?
messages.english: All right. You should turn off the main water for safety. Do you know how to do it?

choices.text: Sì, so dove si trova la valvola generale. La chiudo subito.
choices.english: Yes, I know where the main valve is. I'll close it right away.
choices.feedback: Excellent. Turning off the water prevents further damage.

choices.text: No, non mi piace l'acqua perché preferisco il vino rosso.
choices.english: No, I don't like water because I prefer red wine.
choices.feedback: Safety first! Focus on the water valve.

choices.text: Sì, so cucinare molto bene la pasta al pomodoro.
choices.english: Yes, I know how to cook pasta with tomato sauce very well.
choices.feedback: Not the time for cooking lessons!

messages.text: Bene. Qual è il suo indirizzo preciso?
messages.english: Good. What is your exact address?

choices.text: Abito in Via Roma numero dieci, al secondo piano.
choices.english: I live in Via Roma number ten, on the second floor.
choices.feedback: Great. You gave your complete address.

choices.text: Vado in Via Roma per vedere un film molto famoso.
choices.english: I'm going to Via Roma to see a very famous movie.
choices.feedback: You need to provide your home address for the repair.

choices.text: La strada è molto lunga e ci sono molti alberi verdi.
choices.english: The street is very long and there are many green trees.
choices.feedback: Nice description, but the plumber needs the address.

messages.text: Va bene. È un rubinetto vecchio o è stato installato di recente?
messages.english: Okay. Is it an old faucet or was it installed recently?

choices.text: È un rubinetto molto vecchio, ha più di dieci anni.
choices.english: It is a very old faucet, it's more than ten years old.
choices.feedback: Good information. Old faucets often need replacement parts.

choices.text: Mi piace molto il mio nuovo vestito azzurro per la festa.
choices.english: I really like my new light blue dress for the party.
choices.feedback: The plumber is asking about the faucet, not your clothes.

choices.text: Sì, il tempo è molto bello oggi e c'è il sole.
choices.english: Yes, the weather is very nice today and it's sunny.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the plumber's question.

messages.text: Capito. C'è parcheggio per il mio furgone vicino al suo palazzo?
messages.english: Got it. Is there parking for my van near your building?

choices.text: Sì, c'è un parcheggio riservato proprio davanti all'ingresso.
choices.english: Yes, there is a reserved parking spot right in front of the entrance.
choices.feedback: Helpful! Finding parking can be difficult for repairmen.

choices.text: No, preferisco andare all'aeroporto con il taxi.
choices.english: No, I prefer to go to the airport by taxi.
choices.feedback: Stay focused on the plumber's arrival.

choices.text: Sì, il mio furgone è molto grande e di colore rosso.
choices.english: Yes, my van is very large and red in color.
choices.feedback: The plumber is asking about parking for THEIR van.

messages.text: Perfetto. Sarò da lei tra circa mezz'ora. Va bene?
messages.english: Perfect. I will be at your place in about half an hour. Is that okay?

choices.text: Sì, perfetto. La aspetto a casa. Grazie mille.
choices.english: Yes, perfect. I'll wait for you at home. Thanks a lot.
choices.feedback: Great. You confirmed the appointment and thanked them.

choices.text: No, voglio andare a mangiare un gelato in centro.
choices.english: No, I want to go eat a gelato downtown.
choices.feedback: You need to be home for the plumber!

choices.text: Sì, mi piace aspettare il treno alla stazione centrale.
choices.english: Yes, I like waiting for the train at the central station.
choices.feedback: The plumber is coming to your house, not the station.

messages.text: Ottimo. Se succede qualcos'altro nel frattempo, mi chiami.
messages.english: Great. If anything else happens in the meantime, call me.

choices.text: D'accordo, la chiamo se c'è qualche novità. A dopo.
choices.english: All right, I'll call you if there's any news. See you later.
choices.feedback: Good. You acknowledged the instruction.

choices.text: Sì, chiamo sempre mia madre la domenica mattina.
choices.english: Yes, I always call my mother on Sunday morning.
choices.feedback: The plumber is talking about calling HIM if the leak gets worse.

choices.text: No, non mi piace usare il telefono per parlare.
choices.english: No, I don't like using the phone to talk.
choices.feedback: You might need to call if there's an emergency.

messages.text: Il costo dell'uscita è di trenta euro, più il lavoro. È d'accordo?
messages.english: The call-out fee is thirty euros, plus labor. Do you agree?

choices.text: Sì, va bene. L'importante è risolvere il problema presto.
choices.english: Yes, that's fine. The important thing is to solve the problem soon.
choices.feedback: Good. You accepted the terms of the service.

choices.text: No, preferisco comprare trenta chili di mele al mercato.
choices.english: No, I prefer to buy thirty kilos of apples at the market.
choices.feedback: You need to pay for the repair service.

choices.text: Sì, trenta è un numero molto fortunato per me.
choices.english: Yes, thirty is a very lucky number for me.
choices.feedback: Agree to the price, not just the number.

messages.text: Molto bene. A tra poco allora. Arrivederci.
messages.english: Very well. See you soon then. Goodbye.

choices.text: Arrivederci e a dopo.
choices.english: Goodbye and see you later.
choices.feedback: A polite way to end the call.

choices.text: Buongiorno, vorrei un caffè.
choices.english: Good morning, I'd like a coffee.
choices.feedback: The conversation is over, no need to order coffee.

choices.text: Ciao, dove sono i bagagli?
choices.english: Hi, where is the luggage?
choices.feedback: Irrelevant and out of context.

conversations.title: Broken Light Switch
conversations.description: Report a broken light switch to the apartment manager.

messages.text: Buongiorno, sono l'amministratore. Di cosa ha bisogno?
messages.english: Good morning, I am the manager. What do you need?

choices.text: Buongiorno, un interruttore della luce non funziona più.
choices.english: Good morning, a light switch is no longer working.
choices.feedback: Well done. You identified the broken item correctly.

choices.text: Buongiorno, cerco un ristorante per mangiare la pasta.
choices.english: Good morning, I'm looking for a restaurant to eat pasta.
choices.feedback: The manager can't help with restaurant recommendations now.

choices.text: Ciao, vorrei cambiare la mia macchina con una nuova.
choices.english: Hi, I would like to change my car for a new one.
choices.feedback: Not the right person for car issues!

messages.text: In quale stanza si trova l'interruttore rotto?
messages.english: In which room is the broken switch located?

choices.text: Si trova in bagno, vicino allo specchio grande.
choices.english: It is in the bathroom, near the large mirror.
choices.feedback: Good. Providing the exact location is helpful.

choices.text: Si trova in centro, vicino alla piazza principale.
choices.english: It is in the center, near the main square.
choices.feedback: The manager is asking about a room in your house.

choices.text: Mi piace molto stare in giardino quando fa caldo.
choices.english: I really like being in the garden when it's hot.
choices.feedback: Answer the question about the room first.

messages.text: Succede solo con quel tasto o mancano le luci in tutta la casa?
messages.english: Does it happen only with that button or are the lights out in the whole house?

choices.text: Solo con quell'interruttore. Le altre luci funzionano bene.
choices.english: Only with that switch. The other lights work fine.
choices.feedback: Excellent. This helps identify the scope of the problem.

choices.text: Sì, tutta la mia casa è molto grande e bella.
choices.english: Yes, my whole house is very large and beautiful.
choices.feedback: Answer if the other lights are working or not.

choices.text: Mi piace molto mangiare la pizza in tutta la casa.
choices.english: I really like eating pizza in the whole house.
choices.feedback: Not relevant to the electrical issue.

messages.text: Capito. Ha provato a cambiare la lampadina per sicurezza?
messages.english: Got it. Have you tried changing the light bulb just in case?

choices.text: Sì, ho provato con una lampadina nuova ma non va.
choices.english: Yes, I tried with a new bulb but it doesn't work.
choices.feedback: Good. Troubleshooting confirms the switch is the problem.

choices.text: No, preferisco cambiare il colore delle pareti.
choices.english: No, I prefer to change the color of the walls.
choices.feedback: Stick to the light bulb first.

choices.text: Sì, le lampadine sono molto care al supermercato.
choices.english: Yes, light bulbs are very expensive at the supermarket.
choices.feedback: The manager is asking if you tried changing it.

messages.text: Allora è proprio l'interruttore. Posso mandare un tecnico domani mattina?
messages.english: Then it's definitely the switch. Can I send a technician tomorrow morning?

choices.text: Domani mattina va bene, verso le nove sono a casa.
choices.english: Tomorrow morning is fine, I'm at home around nine.
choices.feedback: Great. You confirmed the time and your availability.

choices.text: Domani mattina vado al mare a nuotare con amici.
choices.english: Tomorrow morning I'm going to the sea to swim with friends.
choices.feedback: If you are not home, the technician cannot enter.

choices.text: Sì, il tecnico è molto bravo a suonare la chitarra.
choices.english: Yes, the technician is very good at playing the guitar.
choices.feedback: That's nice to know, but not relevant to the appointment.

messages.text: Verso le dieci va bene per lei?
messages.english: Is around ten o'clock okay for you?

choices.text: Sì, le dieci è perfetto. La aspetto.
choices.english: Yes, ten is perfect. I'll wait for you.
choices.feedback: Good confirmation of the time.

choices.text: No, ho dieci gatti neri in casa mia.
choices.english: No, I have ten black cats in my house.
choices.feedback: The manager is talking about the time, not cats.

choices.text: Sì, il numero dieci è il mio preferito per il calcio.
choices.english: Yes, number ten is my favorite for soccer.
choices.feedback: Confirm the appointment time.

messages.text: Perfetto. Il tecnico si chiama Marco, è molto bravo.
messages.english: Perfect. The technician's name is Marco, he is very good.

choices.text: D'accordo, aspetterò il signor Marco domani.
choices.english: All right, I will wait for Mr. Marco tomorrow.
choices.feedback: Good. You acknowledged the technician's name.

choices.text: Marco è un nome che mi piace molto per un cane.
choices.english: Marco is a name that I really like for a dog.
choices.feedback: A bit rude! He's a professional technician.

choices.text: Sì, conosco un Marco che vende scarpe in centro.
choices.english: Yes, I know a Marco who sells shoes downtown.
choices.feedback: Probably not the same person.

messages.text: Le lascio il mio numero di cellulare per le urgenze. Lo ha già?
messages.english: I'll leave you my cell phone number for emergencies. Do you already have it?

choices.text: No, non ce l'ho. Lo scrivo subito sul mio telefono.
choices.english: No, I don't have it. I'll write it down on my phone right away.
choices.feedback: Good. Keeping the contact info is important.

choices.text: Sì, ho molti numeri di telefono di ristoranti famosi.
choices.english: Yes, I have many phone numbers of famous restaurants.
choices.feedback: Save the manager's number specifically.

choices.text: Grazie, preferisco scrivere una lettera alla nonna.
choices.english: Thanks, I prefer to write a letter to my grandmother.
choices.feedback: Focus on the manager's contact info.

messages.text: Va bene. Mi raccomando, non tocchi i fili elettrici.
messages.english: Okay. Please, do not touch the electrical wires.

choices.text: Certo, non tocco nulla. È troppo pericoloso.
choices.english: Of course, I won't touch anything. It's too dangerous.
choices.feedback: Safety first! Good decision.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace toccare l'erba verde nel parco.
choices.english: Yes, I like touching the green grass in the park.
choices.feedback: The manager is talking about dangerous wires!

choices.text: No, preferisco toccare lo schermo del mio computer.
choices.english: No, I prefer touching my computer screen.
choices.feedback: Just stay away from the broken switch.

messages.text: D'accordo. Buona giornata e a domani.
messages.english: All right. Have a good day and see you tomorrow.

choices.text: Grazie, buona giornata anche a lei. A domani.
choices.english: Thanks, have a good day too. See you tomorrow.
choices.feedback: A polite and appropriate closing.

choices.text: Ciao, vorrei prenotare un tavolo per tre persone.
choices.english: Hi, I'd like to reserve a table for three people.
choices.feedback: Again, this is the manager, not a restaurant.

choices.text: Sì, domani vado a comprare un nuovo vestito blu.
choices.english: Yes, tomorrow I'm going to buy a new blue dress.
choices.feedback: Stay home for the technician!

conversations.title: Electrical Problem
conversations.description: Call an electrician because there is no power in the living room.

messages.text: Pronto, Elettricista Bianchi. Mi dica pure.
messages.english: Hello, Bianchi Electrician. Go ahead.

choices.text: Buongiorno, non c'è luce nel mio soggiorno. Cosa succede?
choices.english: Good morning, there is no light in my living room. What's happening?
choices.feedback: Correct. You reported the power outage in a specific room.

choices.text: Ciao, vorrei una lampadina molto grande per il giardino.
choices.english: Hi, I would like a very large light bulb for the garden.
choices.feedback: You need to fix the power first, not buy a bulb.

choices.text: Buongiorno, mi piace guardare la televisione al buio.
choices.english: Good morning, I like watching television in the dark.
choices.feedback: The electrician needs to know about the fault.

messages.text: Ha controllato il quadro elettrico generale?
messages.english: Have you checked the main electrical panel?

choices.text: Sì, ho controllato, ma tutto sembra a posto lì.
choices.english: Yes, I checked, but everything seems fine there.
choices.feedback: Good job checking the basics before calling.

choices.text: Sì, il quadro è molto bello, è un regalo di mio padre.
choices.english: Yes, the painting is very beautiful, it's a gift from my father.
choices.feedback: The 'quadro' here means electrical panel, not a painting!

choices.text: No, preferisco guardare le foto sul mio computer.
choices.english: No, I prefer looking at photos on my computer.
choices.feedback: The electrician is giving you troubleshooting steps.

messages.text: È scattato l'interruttore salvavita o è tutto su?
messages.english: Has the circuit breaker tripped or is everything up?

choices.text: L'interruttore è su, quindi il problema è altrove.
choices.english: The switch is up, so the problem is elsewhere.
choices.feedback: Good observation. This means the fuse didn't blow.

choices.text: Sì, l'interruttore è molto piccolo e di colore nero.
choices.english: Yes, the switch is very small and black in color.
choices.feedback: The electrician needs to know if it's 'up' or 'down'.

choices.text: Mi piace molto saltare e correre nel parco.
choices.english: I really like jumping and running in the park.
choices.feedback: Not the kind of 'tripping' he meant!

messages.text: Capisco. Potrebbe essere un cortocircuito. È pericoloso.
messages.english: I see. It could be a short circuit. It's dangerous.

choices.text: Può venire oggi? È urgente perché ho paura.
choices.english: Can you come today? It's urgent because I'm afraid.
choices.feedback: Excellent. Expressing urgency when there's a danger.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace il pericolo quando vado in montagna.
choices.english: Yes, I like danger when I go to the mountains.
choices.feedback: Electrical danger is not fun! Ask for help.

choices.text: Oggi è una bella giornata per andare al parco.
choices.english: Today is a beautiful day to go to the park.
choices.feedback: Focus on the electrical problem at home.

messages.text: Ha altri apparecchi elettrici collegati nel soggiorno?
messages.english: Do you have other electrical appliances connected in the living room?

choices.text: C'è solo la televisione e una lampada da terra.
choices.english: There's only the television and a floor lamp.
choices.feedback: Good. Listing the appliances helps diagnose the load.

choices.text: Sì, ho molti libri di cucina sullo scaffale.
choices.english: Yes, I have many cookbooks on the shelf.
choices.feedback: The electrician asked about electrical appliances.

choices.text: No, preferisco mangiare una mela in cucina.
choices.english: No, I prefer to eat an apple in the kitchen.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the power issue.

messages.text: Forse è la stufa che crea problemi. Può staccarla?
messages.english: Maybe it's the heater causing problems. Can you unplug it?

choices.text: Sì, la stacco subito dalla presa di corrente.
choices.english: Yes, I'll unplug it from the power outlet right away.
choices.feedback: Good. Unplugging faulty appliances is a safe step.

choices.text: No, ho molto freddo e voglio la stufa accesa.
choices.english: No, I'm very cold and I want the heater on.
choices.feedback: It might be dangerous! Better to unplug it for now.

choices.text: Sì, la stufa è molto vecchia e di metallo grigio.
choices.english: Yes, the heater is very old and made of gray metal.
choices.feedback: Unplug it instead of describing it.

messages.text: Bene. Io arrivo tra un'ora per controllare tutto.
messages.english: Good. I'll be there in an hour to check everything.

choices.text: Va bene, la aspetto tra un'ora. Grazie.
choices.english: Okay, I'll wait for you in an hour. Thanks.
choices.feedback: Clear confirmation of the appointment.

choices.text: Un'ora è troppo tempo, preferisco andare al cinema.
choices.english: An hour is too long, I prefer to go to the movies.
choices.feedback: You need to wait for the electrician for your safety.

choices.text: Sì, l'ora è un concetto molto difficile da capire.
choices.english: Yes, time is a very difficult concept to understand.
choices.feedback: Just wait for him!

messages.text: Non provi a riaccendere la luce finché non arrivo.
messages.english: Do not try to turn the light back on until I arrive.

choices.text: Certo, lascio tutto spento. Grazie del consiglio.
choices.english: Of course, I'll leave everything off. Thanks for the advice.
choices.feedback: Following safety advice is the best thing to do.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace accendere molte candele profumate.
choices.english: Yes, I like to light many scented candles.
choices.feedback: He meant the electrical switch!

choices.text: No, voglio vedere bene cosa c'è dentro il frigorifero.
choices.english: No, I want to see clearly what's inside the fridge.
choices.feedback: Keep the power off as instructed.

messages.text: Mi conferma che l'indirizzo è Via Verdi 5?
messages.english: Do you confirm the address is Via Verdi 5?

choices.text: Sì, confermo. Via Verdi numero cinque, interno tre.
choices.english: Yes, I confirm. Via Verdi number five, apartment three.
choices.feedback: Excellent. Providing the apartment number is helpful.

choices.text: No, Via Verdi è una strada molto brutta e sporca.
choices.english: No, Via Verdi is a very ugly and dirty street.
choices.feedback: Just confirm the address.

choices.text: Sì, Giuseppe Verdi è un compositore molto famoso.
choices.english: Yes, Giuseppe Verdi is a very famous composer.
choices.feedback: Not relevant to your address.

messages.text: Arrivo il prima possibile. Stia tranquillo. A dopo.
messages.english: I'll be there as soon as possible. Stay calm. See you later.

choices.text: Grazie, a tra poco. Arrivederci.
choices.english: Thanks, see you soon. Goodbye.
choices.feedback: A calm and polite ending.

choices.text: Ciao, dove sono le chiavi della macchina?
choices.english: Hi, where are the car keys?
choices.feedback: Don't get distracted now.

choices.text: Buongiorno, vorrei comprare un giornale.
choices.english: Good morning, I'd like to buy a newspaper.
choices.feedback: Not relevant.

conversations.title: Fixing the Issue
conversations.description: The repairman is at your house to fix the problem.

messages.text: Buongiorno, sono qui per la riparazione. Dov'è il guasto?
messages.english: Good morning, I'm here for the repair. Where is the fault?

choices.text: Buongiorno, entri pure. Il problema è qui in cucina.
choices.english: Good morning, please come in. The problem is here in the kitchen.
choices.feedback: Good. Inviting the repairman in and showing the location.

choices.text: Ciao, il mio guasto è che non trovo il mio portafoglio.
choices.english: Hi, my fault is that I can't find my wallet.
choices.feedback: The repairman is here for a household fix, not a lost item.

choices.text: Buongiorno, mi piace molto il colore delle sue scarpe.
choices.english: Good morning, I really like the color of your shoes.
choices.feedback: Be professional and show him the repair needed.

messages.text: Vedo. Il tubo è rotto e perde molta acqua. Devo cambiarlo subito.
messages.english: I see. The pipe is broken and leaking a lot of water. I have to change it right away.

choices.text: Va bene. Quanto tempo ci vuole per aggiustarlo?
choices.english: All right. How long does it take to fix it?
choices.feedback: Good. Asking about the time is a standard question.

choices.text: Va bene. Mi piace cambiare i vestiti ogni giorno.
choices.english: All right. I like changing clothes every day.
choices.feedback: The repairman is talking about changing a pipe.

choices.text: Sì, il tubo è molto lungo come un serpente nero.
choices.english: Yes, the pipe is very long like a black snake.
choices.feedback: Just let him do his work.

messages.text: Ho i pezzi di ricambio nel furgone. Vado a prenderli.
messages.english: I have the spare parts in the van. I'll go get them.

choices.text: D'accordo, l'aspetto qui in cucina. Faccia pure.
choices.english: All right, I'll wait for you here in the kitchen. Go ahead.
choices.feedback: Good. You are being patient while he gets his tools.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace molto il pane fresco del furgone bianco.
choices.english: Yes, I really like the fresh bread from the white van.
choices.feedback: He's getting spare parts, not bread!

choices.text: No, preferisco andare a fare una passeggiata lunga.
choices.english: No, I prefer to go for a long walk.
choices.feedback: Wait for the repairman to finish the job.

messages.text: Eccomi. Iniziamo il lavoro. Può spostare queste cose, per favore?
messages.english: Here I am. Let's start the work. Can you move these things, please?

choices.text: Sì, certo. Sposto subito tutto quello che serve.
choices.english: Yes, of course. I'll move everything that's needed right away.
choices.feedback: Helpful! Clearing the work area is important.

choices.text: No, queste cose sono molto pesanti per me.
choices.english: No, these things are very heavy for me.
choices.feedback: Try to help him access the repair site.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace spostare i mobili della camera da letto.
choices.english: Yes, I like moving the bedroom furniture.
choices.feedback: He asked to move things in the kitchen.

messages.text: Grazie. Ci vorranno circa venti minuti per finire.
messages.english: Thank you. It will take about twenty minutes to finish.

choices.text: Nessun problema. Posso offrirle un bicchiere d'acqua?
choices.english: No problem. Can I offer you a glass of water?
choices.feedback: Very kind of you! It's polite to offer a drink to workers.

choices.text: Venti minuti sono troppi per guardare la tv.
choices.english: Twenty minutes are too many to watch TV.
choices.feedback: Be patient while he works.

choices.text: Sì, venti è il mio numero preferito per la pasta.
choices.english: Yes, twenty is my favorite number for pasta.
choices.feedback: Not relevant.

messages.text: Ecco fatto. Ora proviamo se il rubinetto funziona bene.
messages.english: There we go. Now let's test if the faucet works well.

choices.text: Sì, proviamo. Apro l'acqua con cautela.
choices.english: Yes, let's test. I'll turn on the water carefully.
choices.feedback: Good. Testing the repair is the final step.

choices.text: No, ho paura che l'acqua sia troppo fredda.
choices.english: No, I'm afraid the water is too cold.
choices.feedback: You need to check if the leak is gone.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace nuotare nel mare quando è calmo.
choices.english: Yes, I like swimming in the sea when it's calm.
choices.feedback: Focus on the faucet.

messages.text: Sembra tutto a posto adesso. Niente più perdite.
messages.english: Everything seems fine now. No more leaks.

choices.text: Ottimo lavoro! Sono molto contento. Grazie.
choices.english: Great job! I'm very happy. Thank you.
choices.feedback: It's good to show appreciation for a job well done.

choices.text: Peccato, mi piaceva sentire il rumore delle gocce.
choices.english: Too bad, I liked hearing the sound of the drops.
choices.feedback: Leaks are bad for your house!

choices.text: Sì, tutto è a posto quando vado a dormire presto.
choices.english: Yes, everything is fine when I go to sleep early.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant.

messages.text: La riparazione costa cinquanta euro in totale.
messages.english: The repair costs fifty euros in total.

choices.text: Va bene. Accetta pagamenti con la carta?
choices.english: All right. Do you accept card payments?
choices.feedback: Good. Asking about payment methods is important.

choices.text: Cinquanta euro sono troppi per comprare un libro.
choices.english: Fifty euros are too many to buy a book.
choices.feedback: You are paying for professional repair work.

choices.text: Sì, ho cinquanta amici che vivono a Milano.
choices.english: Yes, I have fifty friends who live in Milan.
choices.feedback: Pay the man!

messages.text: Sì, ho il POS. Vuole la ricevuta cartacea o via email?
messages.english: Yes, I have the card reader. Do you want a paper receipt or via email?

choices.text: Preferisco la ricevuta via email, grazie.
choices.english: I prefer the receipt via email, thanks.
choices.feedback: Good. Digital receipts are easy to store.

choices.text: Sì, mi piace molto scrivere sulla carta bianca.
choices.english: Yes, I really like writing on white paper.
choices.feedback: Just choose a receipt format.

choices.text: No, non leggo mai le mie email al mattino.
choices.english: No, I never read my emails in the morning.
choices.feedback: It's just for the receipt.

messages.text: Perfetto. Il lavoro è finito. Buona giornata!
messages.english: Perfect. The work is finished. Have a good day!

choices.text: Grazie a lei e buona giornata. Arrivederci.
choices.english: Thank you and have a good day. Goodbye.
choices.feedback: A polite conclusion to the repair visit.

choices.text: Ciao, vorrei comprare un gelato al cioccolato.
choices.english: Hi, I'd like to buy a chocolate gelato.
choices.feedback: The repairman doesn't sell gelato.

choices.text: Sì, il lavoro è molto stancante per me oggi.
choices.english: Yes, work is very tiring for me today.
choices.feedback: Just say goodbye.
